a:r.a:t: Hard rules for credential and configuration protection
Hard Rule: No Secrets in appsettings
Sensitive values must never be committed to appsettings.json or appsettings.Development.json. This is a non-negotiable security baseline.
Local development secrets are managed through ASP.NET Core User Secrets.
Deployment-time secret management is owned by the deployment team and outside this guideline scope.
Handled via Azure Key Vault, CI/CD pipelines
Operational policy values, feature flags, and non-secret configuration only.
